summary: Prototype: role escalation, browser completion, archive writes, foreign-tour access, legacy signature reads and unbounded client fields are denied. Emulator validation and live database compatibility must be verified before deployment.

findings.recommendation: Do not deploy. Verify current configuration and design an explicitly approved isolated test or coordinated cutover first.
